hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import sys, json, re
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
cmd = data['tool_input']['command']
new_cmd = re.sub(r'^npm install', 'pnpm install', cmd)
new_cmd = re.sub(r'^npm i ', 'pnpm install ', new_cmd)
print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'PreToolUse', 'updatedInput': {'command': new_cmd}}}))
"
